name: Docker
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Integrates Docker with the Omarchy desktop: a themed container view (list), lifecycle commands (start/stop/restart), logs and exec, a daemon/group status check, and a Hyprland keybinding that opens the view in a floating terminal. Colours are read live from the applied theme.

features: Reads the applied theme live from ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml — no baked-in palette, any theme works
list renders containers in a table coloured from the applied theme (running / stopped / other)
status reports whether the Docker daemon is reachable and whether this user is in the docker group, with the exact fix when they are not
start / stop / restart / logs / exec wrap the docker CLI through one injectable seam
theme-set hook (uniquely named docker-theme-set) regenerates the colour roles on every theme change
Hyprland keybinding (Super+Shift+Alt+D) opens the container view in a floating terminal
